# windows_net_ip_address (Resource)

Manages one static IP address on one network interface of a remote Windows host (`New-NetIPAddress` / `Set-NetIPAddress` / `Remove-NetIPAddress` via SSH and PowerShell). Several resources may target the same interface, one per address.

`interface_alias` and `ip_address` are immutable after creation (ForceNew); `prefix_length` and `skip_as_source` are updated in place. The address is stored canonically (`netip`: lower-case, compressed IPv6). The default gateway is deliberately not managed here: it belongs to `windows_net_route`, which would otherwise fight over an address this resource does not own.

Safety — managing the management interface: every mutating operation consults a management-path guard that refuses, fail-closed, to remove or alter the address the provider's own SSH session arrived on (or the route carrying it). When the path cannot be determined the operation is refused as well. `unsafe_skip_management_check` bypasses the guard entirely: the change may apply and still end in an apply error (transport lost, timeout), and the host must stay reachable at the provider `host` address afterwards. Configure the management NIC out-of-band (unattend, cloud-init, DHCP reservation) and manage only secondary NICs with this resource.

Import format: `<interface_alias>|<ip_address>`. Only addresses with prefix origin `Manual` are importable.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    windows = {
      source  = "kfrlabs/windows"
      version = "~> 0.1"
    }
  }
}

provider "windows" {
  host     = var.windows_host
  username = var.windows_username
  password = var.windows_password
}

# Static IPv4 address on a secondary NIC (storage network). The interface
# must already exist; disable_dhcp is required when the interface still has
# DHCP enabled. The default gateway is NOT managed here — use
# windows_net_route for it.
resource "windows_net_ip_address" "storage" {
  interface_alias = "Ethernet 2"
  ip_address      = "192.0.2.10" # documentation range, RFC 5737
  prefix_length   = 24
  disable_dhcp    = true

  # Bound every remote operation explicitly. Without this block each operation
  # defaults to 10 minutes; a stalled PowerShell/SSH session then surfaces a
  # timeout diagnostic instead of blocking Terraform indefinitely.
  timeouts = {
    create = "10m"
    read   = "5m"
    update = "10m"
    delete = "10m"
  }
}

# Static IPv6 address on the same secondary NIC. Several resources may target
# the same interface, one per address.
resource "windows_net_ip_address" "storage_v6" {
  interface_alias = "Ethernet 2"
  ip_address      = "2001:db8::10" # documentation range, RFC 3849
  prefix_length   = 64
}

output "storage_address_state" {
  value       = windows_net_ip_address.storage.address_state
  description = "Duplicate-detection state of the storage address (Preferred when healthy)."
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `interface_alias` (String) Network interface alias (e.g. `"Ethernet 2"`). Matched exactly and case-insensitively, never as a wildcard. Immutable after creation (ForceNew). Must not contain `|` (used as the import-ID separator).
- `ip_address` (String) Static IPv4 or IPv6 address, stored canonically. Unspecified, loopback, multicast, IPv4 broadcast and zone-ID (`%eth0`) addresses are rejected; link-local addresses warn. Immutable after creation (ForceNew).
- `prefix_length` (Number) Subnet prefix length: 1-32 for IPv4, 1-128 for IPv6 (validated against the address family at plan time). Updated in place.

### Optional

- `disable_dhcp` (Boolean) IPv4 only: disables DHCP on the interface before creating the address (required when the interface still has DHCP enabled). Tracked in private state so destroy with `restore_dhcp_on_destroy` can re-enable it. Defaults to `false`.
- `restore_dhcp_on_destroy` (Boolean) When `true`, destroy re-enables DHCP on the interface, but only if this resource disabled it. Defaults to `false`: destroy only removes the address. Forcing a new lease (`ipconfig /renew`) is a manual step and out of scope.
- `skip_as_source` (Boolean) Excludes the address from outbound source selection. Updated in place. Defaults to `false`.
- `timeouts` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeouts))
- `unsafe_skip_management_check` (Boolean) Bypasses the management-path guard entirely. The change may apply and still end in an apply error (transport lost, timeout); the host must stay reachable at the provider `host` address afterwards. Defaults to `false`.

### Read-Only

- `address_family` (String) Address family, as observed on the host: `IPv4` or `IPv6`.
- `address_state` (String) Duplicate-detection state, as observed on the host: `Preferred`, `Tentative`, `Duplicate` or `Deprecated`.
- `id` (String) Resource identifier: `<interface_alias>|<canonical ip_address>`.
- `interface_index` (Number) Numeric interface index owning the address, as observed on the host.
- `prefix_origin` (String) How the address was provisioned, as observed on the host: `Manual`, `Dhcp`, `WellKnown`, `RouterAdvertisement` or `Other`.

<a id="nestedatt--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `create` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).
- `delete` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours). Setting a timeout for a Delete operation is only applicable if changes are saved into state before the destroy operation occurs.
- `read` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours). Read operations occur during any refresh or planning operation when refresh is enabled.
- `update` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import an existing static IP address by <interface_alias>|<ip_address>.
# Only addresses with prefix origin Manual are importable.
terraform import windows_net_ip_address.storage "Ethernet 2|192.0.2.10"
```
